name: oclaunch
description: OCLaunch — community review-to-improvement workspace for solo founders

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @oclaunch/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c orange,teal "npm run dev -w @oclaunch/web" "npm run dev -w @oclaunch/platform"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oclaunch/shared && npm run build -w @oclaunch/web && npm run build -w @oclaunch/platform
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @oclaunch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @oclaunch/web && npm run typecheck -w @oclaunch/platform
scripts.test: npm run test -w @oclaunch/shared && npm run test -w @oclaunch/platform && npm run test -w @oclaunch/web
